_comment: Who to talk to about what. `people` are as listed on the Our Team page (https://hiappleseed.org/our-team: names, titles and the work email each person publishes there, checked 2026-10-21); build_index.py checks that every name and title here is in content/about.md's Staff list and vice versa. `routes` are which of them to suggest for which topic: drawn from their titles and bios by Claude as a first draft, so staff must review them. The assistant may name at most two people from here, and the page then offers an email button for them; it never invents a person, title, address or area. `status` is "draft" until staff approve the people and routes in the sign-off review (approved by NAME YYYY-MM-DD, with `reviewed`: a hash of these exact words); a --public build leaves the whole thing out until then.

people.name: Arjuna Heim
people.title: Director of Research and Director of Housing Policy

routes.about: Housing: renters, rent, eviction, zoning and parking, empty homes, affordable housing
Transportation equity: transit, fare-free transit, pedestrian safety
Food equity: SNAP and school meals

routes.note: The Our Team page lists no one with a wages or labor title. The Director of Research is the closest by title; the Executive Director or the office can route a question about wages, paid leave, or pay transparency.

routes.about: Research and data: the reports, their numbers and methods
Volunteering, community organizing, workshops, and joining a coalition
Partnerships, speaking invitations, and anything about the organization as a whole
